title: APD Gauntlet Defense Graph
description: Defense overlay showing D3FEND techniques that counter attack techniques traversing bottleneck edges. Each bottleneck carries the exposed attack techniques, candidate D3FEND counters, and the capability-backing status of each.

edge_id.description: Unique identifier for this bottleneck edge

paths_traversing.description: Number of attack paths that traverse this edge (must be >= 2 to be a bottleneck)

exposed_attack_techniques.description: ATT&CK techniques that traverse this bottleneck

counters.description: ATT&CK techniques this D3FEND technique counters

rationale.description: Explanation of why this D3FEND technique counters the exposed attacks

candidate_d3fend.description: D3FEND techniques that could counter attacks on this bottleneck

capability_ids.description: Existing capabilities that implement this D3FEND technique

existing_capability_backing.description: D3FEND techniques already backed by confirmed capabilities

net_new_d3fend.description: D3FEND techniques from candidate_d3fend that have no existing capability backing

bottleneck_overlays.description: Defensive overlays on each bottleneck edge in the attack graph

bottleneck_edge_count.description: Total number of bottleneck edges analyzed

total_candidate_d3fend.description: Total unique D3FEND techniques across all bottlenecks

total_net_new_d3fend.description: Total D3FEND techniques without existing capability backing
